title: Table friction force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the kinetic friction force between table and cardboard as μ(m₁+m₂)g = 1 N.

title: Sliding condition derivation
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to both objects to derive the critical force F > 2μg(m₁+m₂) = 2 N.

title: Object acceleration calculation
description: Important: Correctly determines the object's acceleration during contact as a₂ = μg = 2 m/s².

title: Total displacement check
description: Essential: Calculates total displacement s = x₁ + x₂ = 0.18 m and compares it to table edge distance d = 0.15 m.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: Uses kinematic equations correctly for both acceleration and deceleration phases of the object's motion.

title: Final conclusion
description: Essential: Concludes correctly that the object falls off the table since 0.18 m > 0.15 m.

title: Incorrect friction assignment
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong mass when calculating friction forces (e.g., uses only m₁ for table friction).

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in force equations or incorrectly assigns friction directions.
